t: Release Package Builder - public implementations survey
title: Release Package Builder - public implementations survey
definition: Assembles files and metadata for a software release.
description:
This database surveys Release Package Builder as it exists in public practice: Assembles files and metadata for a software release. The records below name real tools with real track records, explain the techniques they are built on, cite the standards they implement, and provide drills that build working skill. Nothing here is speculative - every implementation is a real project you can download, every technique is established practice.

The value of a survey like this is comparative: seeing seven real implementations side by side reveals what the capability truly requires and where each tool draws its boundaries. The technique records go deeper, explaining the machinery - the algorithms, protocols and disciplines - that make Release Package Builder work regardless of which tool you pick.

Use this database as a field guide. When a build calls for Release Package Builder, consult the spotlights to choose an implementation, check the standards to stay interoperable, and run the drills to build fluency. Each record's demo program runs with node - the capability is demonstrated end to end.

t: Release Package Builder failure-mode drill - practitioner discipline
title: Release Package Builder failure-mode drill - practitioner discipline
definition: The failure-mode drill discipline for Release Package Builder: assembles files and metadata for a software release..
description:
Good Release Package Builder practice is not talent - it is failure-mode drill. It turns Release Package Builder from an event into a repeatable capability.

Concretely: run the smallest meaningful case first and verify it by hand; log every decision with its reason, so the next builder inherits understanding; verify outputs against the original request, not against your hopes This record exists because the difference between a tool and a capability is discipline. Run the demo, adopt the checklist, and Release Package Builder becomes something your builds can rely on.

t: Foundation drill - label the seven pillars of the Signature Release Package Bui
title: Foundation drill - label the seven pillars of the Signature Release Package Bui

Drill (FOUNDATION): label the seven pillars of the Signature Release Package Builder on a blank diagram

Success criterion: another builder agrees your labels match the framework
